PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 16, 18, 24, 27, 51, 53, 57, 75, 79, 83, 119, 123, 125, 127, 129, 131, 135, 136, 137, 139, 157, 158, 164, 168 and 171 of Block 08, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 710012, situated in the Village of Pethiyagoda within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 11D - Diyakombala in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rideemaliyadda, in the District of Badulla, in the Province of Uva, referred to in Notice No. 71/0052 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1755/12 of 25th April, 2012 in terms of Section 12 of the Registra-tion of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. M. H. PRIYADHARSHANI, Commissioner General of Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 19th September, 2019.
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
